corrections.reason: The top ring of ሶ (7th order) was slightly faint and misread as ሰ; classical Ge'ez conditional particle ሶበሰ ('if indeed', matching L30).
The 6th-order fidel ስ was misread as ከ; the Amharic commentary states 'ስም መስማቱ በማየት ይፈጸምልናል' ('hearing the name will be fulfilled for us by seeing').
Faint top connector on መ caused it to be misread as ው; Ge'ez conjunction እስመ introducing the following clause.
Visual confusion of ደሉ with ልው; standard patristic Ge'ez citation 'በኃይል ወበስብሐት ዘይደሉ ለመለኮት' ('in power and glory that befits the Godhead').
1st-order ነ was misread as 6th-order ን; standard Amharic 1st person singular imperfective 'እነግራችኋለሁ' ('I tell you').
The 1st-order የ prefix on የ፬ ቀን ሬሳ ('a 4-day corpse') was misread as 4th-order ያ.
The 6th-order ል in ይደነቃልና (singular verb agreeing with the infinitive subject ማስነሣት) was misread as ሉ.
Rejoined across L24-L25 as 'አጽራሪሁ ለሰብእ' ('the enemies of man', plural of ጸር, explained immediately as death, sin, retribution, and Satan); ጽራሪሁ was visually misread as ድዋኒሁ.
